overview.text: Ultravioleta DAO presents x402 payment verification and settlement without accounts, API keys or a facilitator fee. It says buyers sign payments and the facilitator covers network gas; 0% fees and zero agent gas do not make the purchased resource free. The homepage lists seven stablecoins across mainnets and testnets, with balances labelled as network-fee funding rather than revenue. It also describes ERC-8004 identity and reputation, escrow and usage-based payments. The older refund extension is explicitly retired in version 2.59.0 in favor of escrow. Settlement and evidence claims are operator descriptions, not independently verified outcomes.
